about.text: Stretch-curd cheeses are those prepared using the pasta filata technique. They are also known as pulled-curd and plastic-curd cheeses. The cheeses manufactured from this technique undergo a plasticising and kneading treatment of the fresh curd in hot water, which gives them fibrous structures.
